summary:
Team GeoSphere developed Earth Trend Explorer, an interactive web platform that transforms complex, raw satellite datasets into accessible, actionable environmental insights across Africa.

Turning Earth science data into usable intelligence typically requires specialized technical expertise and heavy processing infrastructure. Earth Trend Explorer addresses this challenge through a modular backend that automates data retrieval, geographic filtering, and cleaning. Users simply select an environmental variable, time frame, and custom map region to instantly generate visualizations, statistically validated trend analyses, and AI-driven forecasts.

This capability is vital for disaster preparedness and climate resilience. When tested against the catastrophic April 2024 West African heatwave—where temperatures exceeded 48.5°C and caused hundreds of fatalities—our AI model, trained on 20 years of NASA satellite data, accurately predicted the event 30 days in advance. By democratizing environmental analytics and providing critical early warnings, Earth Trend Explorer empowers governments and humanitarian organizations to mobilize resources ahead of climate emergencies and save lives.
details:
Earth Trend Explorer is a scientifically verified, interactive Earth science web platform dedicated to analyzing climate trends across Africa’s 5 macro-regions (North, West, Central, East, and Southern Africa). It transforms 21 years of monthly NASA satellite observations (2004–2024; 1,260 data points) into actionable statistical insights and next-month extreme climate risk estimates.

Key Highlights at a Glance

  • The Problem: Africa is disproportionately affected by climate extremes, but raw NASA satellite files (NetCDF/HDF) require specialized programming to process, while popular dashboards often show simple linear lines that confuse short-term seasonal weather with long-term climate change.
  • The Solution: A decoupled web platform combining an interactive Laravel/Leaflet frontend with an asynchronous Python FastAPI statistical microservice (SciPy, NumPy, Statsmodels) that delivers instant, verified analytics without writing a single line of code.
  • 100% Real NASA Data:
    • Surface Temperature Anomaly (∘C^\circ\text{C}∘C): NASA GISTEMP v4
    • Precipitation Rate (mm/day\text{mm/day}mm/day): NASA POWER / MERRA-2
    • Zero synthetic, fabricated, or simulated numbers.
  • Core Capabilities:
    1. Non-Parametric Trend Testing: Computes Mann-Kendall rank tests and Sen’s slope estimators on annual means to isolate true climate trajectories from seasonal noise, reporting slope per decade, Kendall’s τ\tauτ, exact ppp-values, and α=0.05\alpha = 0.05α=0.05 significance verdicts.
    2. 5 Specialized Chart Perspectives: Toggle instantly between Trending (monthly series + Sen's slope), Mann-Kendall / Sen's slope (annual averages), Correlation (with 95% Fisher CI), Linear Regression (OLS fit), and Regression Residuals (model fit error over time).
    3. "Predict Next Month" ML Risk Scoring: An extreme-anomaly classifier (Model 1 v6) predicting the risk probability and lift of extreme climate events for the upcoming month (walk-forward validated for temperature with ROC-AUC 0.753; transparently labeled as advisory for precipitation).
    4. Collapsible "How to Read This Chart" Panel: An educational layer explaining the technical axes and dynamically synthesizing real-time statistical conclusions for the active selection.

The Big Takeaway

Earth Trend Explorer bridges academic-grade climate statistics and modern web design, empowering researchers, policy planners, and agricultural organizations with transparent, reliable climate intelligence for the African continent.
